description: Search speeches within a required parliamentary session, optionally by member, party, reply exclusion and heading tokens. Heading matching searches debate headings only, never body text. Search hydrates one text page by default; use get mode with an item speechId to read all remaining text and retain the returned revision for continuation.

headingContains.description: Search only: all-token local heading and subheading filter, ignoring case and diacritics; never body search.

limit.description: Search only: requested rows, default 5 and applied maximum 20.

memberId.description: Search only: numeric memberId from riksdag_search_members, retaining leading zeros.

mode.description: Search by default; get reads one retrieval speechId.

offset.description: Search only: local row offset, default 0.

party.description: Search only: official party code or exact reference label.

revision.description: Search candidate revision or get textRevision copied from the preceding page.

session.description: Required in search mode; parliamentary session such as 2024/25.

speechId.description: Required in get mode: retrieval ID copied from a search item, never the source UUID.

speechType.description: Search only: all by default; speech excludes replies.

textCount.description: Search only: maximum speeches to request text for, default 1 and applied maximum 5; 0 returns metadata.

textLength.description: Get only: requested Unicode code points; defaults start at 8000 and fit the complete response; explicit lengths are honored.

textOffset.description: Get only: Unicode code-point offset, default 0.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Unknown code, conflicting mode fields or malformed identifier. `revision_changed`: Continuation revision no longer matches. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: Detail identity/filter rows contradict required identity. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Present payload violates wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: Network/5xx or HTML error page after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: Process upstream queue is full. `candidate_limit_reached`: Complete-list safety boundary reached. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
